metadata.description: Claude Code plugin marketplace for dotclaude presets.

plugins.name: developer
plugins.description: Extends ai-native with cross-stack developer tooling — GitHub ops, quality gates, and architecture planning. Security and TDD are intentionally left to language/framework presets.

plugins.name: ai-native
plugins.description: Extends core with AI self-learning and skill creation — for users who want Claude to improve with their personal workflow over time.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Universal baseline for any Claude Code user — context management, productivity, and semantic search.

plugins.name: typescript
plugins.description: TypeScript language preset — type-safe coding style, idiomatic patterns, testing, security, and a dedicated TS code reviewer. Foundation for any TS-based framework preset.

plugins.name: nestjs
plugins.description: NestJS framework preset — modular TypeScript backend with DTO validation, guards, database integration, and API design patterns.

plugins.name: nextjs
plugins.description: Next.js framework preset — React app structure, Turbopack dev server, and frontend patterns for production apps.

plugins.name: dotclaude-bootstrap
plugins.description: Bootstrap preset for new dotclaude users — includes the setup wizard, preset creation wizard, debugger, and external plugin discovery. Install at user level.

plugins.name: dotclaude-self
plugins.description: Full dotclaude working environment — preset authoring wizards, self-learning, component picker, and skill creator. Use when working inside the cloned dotclaude repo.

plugins.name: workflow-browser@0.1.0
plugins.description: Extends developer with the w-task-v2 workflow skill — adds Phase 4c browser-based localhost verification between TDD green and commit. Claude starts the local dev server, uses Chrome DevTools MCP (evaluate_script + screenshots) to verify UI changes at localhost only, then gates on developer review before committing. Requires chrome-devtools-mcp and project.dev_server_command in workflow.yaml.

plugins.name: workflow-browser
plugins.description: Extends developer with the w-task workflow skill (v2 with browser verify) — adds Phase 4c browser-based localhost verification between TDD green and commit. Claude starts the local dev server, uses Chrome DevTools MCP (evaluate_script + screenshots) to verify UI changes at localhost only, then gates on developer review before committing. Requires chrome-devtools-mcp and project.dev_server_command in workflow.yaml. v0.3.0 workflow v2: per-repo/submodule default branches (main vs master) via workflow.yaml repos[], terminal one-PR-per-repo Phase 6, and w-setup version detection + auto-migration. v0.4.0 adds the f-setup command (required by f-extract/f-implement — they read .claude/figma.yaml); previously missing so /f-extract could not be configured. v0.5.0 extends the `figma` preset — official Figma MCP suite, four Figma subagents and the always-on figma-fidelity rule — and picks up w-task's engine-aware Phase 3 with its new 3.4 visual parity gate. The f-* skills stay installed as the REST-server fallback. v0.6.0 workflow v3: adds the CodeGraph fast path (`w-codegraph`) for Phases 0b/2/4, splits Phase 4c's non-run outcomes so a browser MCP held by another session waits and then asks the operator instead of being marked skipped, adds Phase 5b acceptance verification (`w-acceptance-verify`) with a bounded fix-commit-redocument loop, and makes Phase 6.3 commit and push the final state into the PR. Requires workflow.yaml v3 — `/w-setup` migrates.

plugins.name: nestjs-nextjs
plugins.description: Full-stack NestJS + Next.js development workflow — TDD, Figma design integration, browser verification, and doc governance. Combines the full w-task workflow suite (intake → context → plan → impact → UI/Figma → TDD → browser-verify → docs → PR) with the f-* Figma skill suite and Chrome DevTools MCP for localhost UI verification. v0.3.0 workflow v2: per-repo/submodule default branches (main vs master) via workflow.yaml repos[], terminal one-PR-per-repo Phase 6, and w-setup version detection + auto-migration. DEPRECATED as of v0.4.0 — superseded by `nextjs-combo`, which is the maintained successor (official Figma MCP suite, Figma subagents, visual parity gate, infra security review). v0.4.0 only extends the `figma` preset so existing installs keep working with w-task's engine-aware Phase 3; no further features will land here. v0.5.0 is likewise a compatibility bump only — it installs the two skills workflow v3 added (`w-codegraph`, `w-acceptance-verify`) so existing installs keep working with the updated w-task. New work belongs in `nextjs-combo`.

plugins.name: figma
plugins.description: Figma design-to-code suite built on the OFFICIAL Figma MCP server (https://mcp.figma.com/mcp). Vendors Figma's own eight Agent Skills from openai/skills and wires each one to a purpose-built subagent: figma-context-extractor (absorbs the large get_design_context / get_variable_defs / get_screenshot payloads and writes an exact figma-spec.md), figma-asset-fetcher (downloads real icons and images from the MCP asset endpoint — never generates SVG or substitutes an icon pack), figma-design-system-mapper (resolves Figma variables and components against the project's real tokens and component library), and figma-visual-verifier (renders the built screen in Chrome, diffs computed styles against the spec, and fails the task on any drift). The always-on figma-fidelity rule forbids invented assets, rounded spacing and guessed colours, and figma-verify-parity gates completion on a PASS verdict. Replaces the legacy REST-based f-* flow, which had no rendered reference, no real asset export, and no verification loop.

plugins.name: nextjs-combo
plugins.description: Full-stack NestJS + Next.js development workflow. Combines the w-task state machine (intake → context → plan → impact → UI/Figma → TDD → browser-verify → docs → PR) with the official Figma design-to-code suite: figma-context-extractor absorbs the MCP payloads into an exact figma-spec.md, figma-asset-fetcher downloads real icons and images instead of generating them, figma-design-system-mapper resolves Figma values against the project's own tokens and components, and a Phase 3.4 visual parity gate blocks the task until computed styles match the design. Includes Chrome DevTools MCP for localhost verification, the cloud-infrastructure security review checklist, and the terraform MCP server for IaC. Supersedes the deprecated `nestjs-nextjs` preset. v1.1.0 workflow v3: a CodeGraph fast path (`w-codegraph`) lets Phases 0b/2/4 query a code knowledge graph instead of grepping the tree; Phase 4c splits its non-run outcomes and waits out a busy browser MCP before asking the operator rather than self-recording a skip; new Phase 5b (`w-acceptance-verify`) traces every ticket requirement to evidence and compares the UI against the Figma export, fixing findings in at most three committed and re-documented iterations; and Phase 6.3 commits and pushes the final task state into the PR so a finished run never leaves a dirty tree. Requires workflow.yaml v3 — `/w-setup` migrates.
